$comment: Cases for a heartbeat, <data>/bridge/<adapter>/panel.json (app/schema/heartbeat.v1.schema.json), read at `now`. `running` is whether app/installer.mts's heartbeatAlive counts it as a script running (app/installer.test.mts), and `online` is whether app/bridge-status.mts's readBridgeStatus calls the bridge online when its status.json carries the same alive/stopped (the case's doc with the other status fields filled in; app/installer.test.mts), and `schema` whether the schema accepts it. The two readers differ on purpose: the install guard waits 30 s and the bridge routes 8 s; a stamp over 5 minutes ahead is not running to the guard, so a stale file from a fast clock can never block installs for good, but online to the routes, so a bridge on a machine whose clock runs ahead (Razor Enhanced on another PC) is never shut out, while the bridge itself refuses any command whose stamp it finds wrong; and stopped: true ends a script for the guard at once, while the routes let the 8 s window run out. adapters/test_panel.py checks the heartbeats the panel really writes have the fields and types of the first case (while it runs) and of the second (once stopped).

cases.why: an alive that is not a time
